title: Virtual-Reality Experience (First devlog)
text: Hello everyone, welcome to our first devlog on the official Fun_Studio15 Website. Today we'll be talking about a game we've been working on for the past few months and maybe talk about a release date: We've been making a game where you don't use the controller sticks to walk around, instead you actually have to walk around. All we can say right now is that we are really proud of the concept and are happy to release it in just a few months. The game will be playable on: PC-VR and maybe Standalone on the Meta Quest 3. We will be sharing a lot more in 2027. Thanks for everything and until then, bye.
